panels.description: Fleet-level prioritization of databases by pgAssistant priority_score and workload/IO signals.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest_snapshot AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (q.target_id)
      q.target_id,
      q.run_id,
      q.collected_at
  FROM pga_ranked_query_snapshot q
  LEFT JOIN pga_collection_run r ON r.run_id = q.run_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(q.collected_at)
    AND r.environment IN (${environment:sqlstring})
    AND q.target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring})
  ORDER BY q.target_id, q.collected_at DESC
),
current_ranked_queries AS (
  SELECT q.*
  FROM pga_ranked_query_snapshot q
  JOIN latest_snapshot ls
    ON ls.target_id = q.target_id
   AND ls.run_id = q.run_id
  WHERE q.priority_level IN (${priority_level:sqlstring})
)
SELECT
  target_id,
  count(*) AS ranked_queries,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE priority_level = 'High') AS high_priority_queries,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE priority_level = 'Medium') AS medium_priority_queries,
  round(max(priority_score)::numeric, 1) AS max_priority_score,
  round(avg(priority_score)::numeric, 1) AS avg_priority_score,
  round(sum(priority_score)::numeric, 1) AS total_priority_score,
  round(sum(total_exec_time_ms)::numeric, 2) AS total_exec_time_ms,
  round(avg(mean_exec_time_ms)::numeric, 2) AS avg_mean_exec_time_ms,
  sum(calls) AS total_calls,
  sum(coalesce(shared_blks_read,0)) AS shared_blks_read,
  sum(coalesce(temp_blks_read,0) + coalesce(temp_blks_written,0)) AS temp_io_blocks,
  max(collected_at) AS last_collected_at,
  (
      coalesce(max(priority_score), 0) * 10
    + coalesce(avg(priority_score), 0) * 3
    + count(*) FILTER (WHERE priority_level = 'High') * 100
    + count(*) FILTER (WHERE priority_level = 'Medium') * 30
    + least(coalesce(sum(shared_blks_read),0), 100000) / 100.0
    + least(coalesce(sum(temp_blks_read + temp_blks_written),0), 100000) / 100.0
  )::numeric(12,1) AS db_optimization_score
FROM current_ranked_queries
GROUP BY target_id
ORDER BY db_optimization_score DESC, max_priority_score DESC, high_priority_queries DESC
LIMIT 50;
